PM handoff — PR #14 accepted; one guarded runtime-initialization repair authorized

EARWORM_ASSIGNMENT_ID=earworm-frame-lattice-init-repair-v1
Instruction version: 1

Source PR: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/14
Reviewed publication: `7b77446b8b16360ed0ab2d1a45f38c82226291a3`
Confirmed merge / exact next base: `b09080567f46adedd1b1f3901a1afab100d3dc2b`
Review: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/14#pullrequestreview-5262317123
Failed execution: `9708e34e0f445c23f99b9420a5d9c50e0d95e537`
Failure receipt: https://github.com/trinitron88/earworm/pull/2#issuecomment-5753936078

Selected invalid branch. Accept the failure checkpoint, but make no scientific inference about the lattice. Saved review verifies 44 chained records, 21 arrived chunks / 21,504 samples from one stream, zero forecast commits/reveals/scores, no calibration or heldout start, unchanged scientific sources after the attempted execution, 39 valid package checksums and 645 preserved historical artifacts. The concrete blocker is a lazy `numpy.median` helper import after the unchanged filesystem/network/process audit guard was installed.

No active successor exists. Authorization below is one targeted implementation-AND-run repair under Brian's continuous 24/7 in-plan delegation. Reconcile live main, this exact comment/version/assignment, the completion receipt, processed-state and no-overlap lock. Reuse matching work if present; never restart or dispatch a duplicate.

Which finish-line capability does this assignment establish or unblock? A causally isolated, boundary-free continuous-audio representation that can use earlier listening state for recognition and calibrated forecasts. Runtime isolation must work before the frame lattice can be judged or later used for long-term transformed-material recognition.

Decision: does pre-initializing the already-required numerical helper before the unchanged audit guard permit the exact frame-lattice scientific test to execute validly?
Result A → if runtime isolation and every original recognition, forecast, calibration, control, latency and safety gate pass, retain the lattice as the versioned streaming reference; after exact-head review advance to one bounded isolated-voice transformation milestone.
Result B → if isolation, source recognition, transformation alignment, causality, latency and family-safety gates pass but proper-score/ambiguity/readout gates fail, retain only the representation candidate and make the next decision about one bounded readout/calibration repair; do not claim an accepted listener.
Result C → if source recognition, forecast advantage, causal controls, family safety or latency fails, reject the lattice and checkpoint the continuous-representation prerequisite; do not return to NSDF boundary/window micro-repairs.
Invalid/inconclusive → preserve evidence and stop without retry, guard relaxation, evaluation retuning or forced architectural choice.
Stop condition: one guarded preflight, finite development/calibration, one frozen heldout evaluation, one complete reproducible successor, awaiting-review, then stop. No worker self-dispatch.

TARGETED REPAIR ONLY

Create `experiments/frame-lattice-init-repair-v1/` from exact main `b09080567f46adedd1b1f3901a1afab100d3dc2b`. Preserve `experiments/causal-frame-lattice-v1/`, E08 and every historical package byte-for-byte.

Keep PR #14's scientific `model.py`, lattice rules, candidate grid f32/f48/f64, alignment/readout, probability coordinates, comparators, metrics, branch precedence and gates byte-identical. The only listener-runtime change is initialization order in the isolated worker:
1. Before installing the audit hook, explicitly initialize the exact `numpy.median` helper path already used by the frozen model.
2. Install the same audit guard with no new allowlist, exception, path permission or relaxation.
3. In a disposable non-evaluation listener, under the installed guard, exercise init/arrive/forecast/save/restore/reset using a fixed synthetic smoke buffer; verify forecast bytes survive save/restore and a deliberate forbidden open is still blocked.
4. Record source hashes, initialization action, guard events and preflight result durably. If any under-guard operation attempts filesystem/network/process access or differs after restore, checkpoint INVALID before creating `STARTED.json` or generating scientific audio. No second repair/retry in this assignment.

Do not replace `np.median` with a different scientific computation, change alignment thresholds, warm from evaluation data, weaken process isolation or edit the failed package. Import initialization must occur before listening and may not inspect repository/evaluation contents beyond normal already-loaded program modules.

FRESH EXECUTION

Use 40 entirely fresh normalized controlled monophonic figure groups, 8 development / 8 calibration / 24 heldout, excluding all identities and waveform seeds from PRs #8–#14. All variants of a motif family remain in one split. Preserve the same detached, legato, duration-change and joint timbre/duration/legato cells and the same explicit limitations. This is still a synthetic short-buffer prerequisite with zero eviction—not a natural-music, polyphony or long-term-memory claim.

Retain the original 20 episode/control streams and four future-invariance probes per group. Perform the save/restore test on one already-counted probe rather than allocating a separate stream. Thus the repaired execution uses at most 960 streams; together with PR #14's one entered stream, cumulative work remains <=961 and does not split the study to evade the 1,000-stream cap.

Development selects among exactly f32/f48/f64 using the frozen objective. Calibration fits no parameter: uncertainty scalar remains fixed at 1, with integrity checks only. If no development configuration is feasible, or calibration invalidates integrity, stop before heldout. Heldout runs once.

Keep raw PCM and each frame's sample bounds/hash, pitch candidates/unknown mass, spectral shape, energy and actual computation/availability clocks immutable and separate from alignments, interpretations and forecasts. No note boundaries, event crops/aggregation, expected-pitch snapping, generator metadata, learned controller, neural training, new encoder or MERT change/download.

FAIR COMPARISON AND CONTROLS

Use the exact PR #14 comparison plan: selected lattice marginal/present, recency, transitions 1–3, absolute sequence retrieval, transformation-aware sequence retrieval and fixed single-window retrieval, alongside frozen trim16, PR #13 MAP/mixture, whole-span, fixed64ms and evaluator-only supplied-boundary oracle. Give operational methods equal arrived audio, history and state budgets. The evaluation archive and truth/oracle files remain inaccessible to the worker.

Preserve byte-identical paired current probes, balanced source inventory/order/recency, reset, relevant-memory removal, swap, whole-figure shuffle, ambiguous history, similar-unrelated rejection and valid labels. Recognition of the prior source, transformation estimate and future forecast remain separate outputs. Nonzero transposition is not part of this controlled stage and must not be claimed.

Forecast logs are hash-chained, append-only and fsynced before continuation audio arrives or is extracted. Verify unrevealed-future invariance, process isolation, exact save/restore determinism and non-overlapping target windows.

PREREGISTER AND FREEZE

Before generating or exposing heldout audio, post one PR #2 receipt with exact base and frozen execution commit; hashes for the byte-identical scientific model and changed worker/preflight; protocol/config/split/model hashes; fresh exclusions/seeds; selected development configuration; fixed calibration scalar; alignment/state budgets; probability coordinates; target windows; actual feature/forecast latency clocks; cumulative resource ledger including the failed attempt; bootstrap seed/quantiles; all gates and branch precedence.

One heldout execution only. No group replacement, evaluation tuning, acoustic rerun, threshold weakening or post-failure second repair.

The original acceptance gates from assignment comment 5753677963 remain binding:
- validity, fresh split, pre-reveal durability, arrived-only guard, future invariance, exact save/restore, equal memory, historical hashes and independent saved reconstruction;
- source retrieval >=.90 overall and >=.80 each cell; similar-unrelated false match <=.10;
- transformation-label accuracy >=.80 in declared changed conditions;
- paired forecast success >=.80 each cell; familywise operational-minus-oracle lower95 >=-.10 each cell;
- positive joint lower95 advantage over present-only and strongest non-oracle operational comparator;
- joint log-loss increase <=.10 and Brier increase <=.02 versus oracle;
- frozen reset/removal/swap/shuffle/ambiguity controls;
- no rendering family loss >.10 versus oracle;
- completed-feature and forecast latency <=160 ms, with computation and dispatch separate and no backdating.
Use 5,000 paired equal-group bootstrap samples and the frozen familywise quantiles. Report all models/cells/controls, source/rejection/transformation, forecast accuracy/both-members/proper scores/calibration, unknown mass/entropy, alignment coverage/error, preservation detail, latency, compute, state and storage separately.

RESOURCES, PUBLICATION AND STOP

Cumulative failed-attempt plus repair limits: <=1,000 streams; <=2 hours aggregate local compute using PR #14's conservative 840.093 seconds against the total (therefore <=6,300 additional seconds); <=2 GiB combined new artifacts; <=32 arrived chunks per forecast; <=2-second completed waveform units. Count every smoke operation, acoustic execution, candidate configuration and probe. Count all predictor-accessible raw buffers, lattice/alignment state, retrieval records and caches. Do not split work to evade limits.

No spending, paid compute/fallback, limit increase, purchased/reset credits, foundation-model training, download, MERT change, deployment, force-push or signal-only commit. If resources or required evidence are unavailable, preserve the exact recoverable checkpoint and known reset information; no busy retries or historical regeneration.

Publish ONE complete successor targeting main with isolated repair code, preflight/guard evidence, frozen protocol/config/split hashes, fresh recipes/audio hashes, acoustic cache, frame/alignment provenance, pre-reveal logs, save/restore proof, independent saved validation, every group/model/control result, concise report, original execution-versus-publication provenance, checksums, checkpoint and ordinary `PROJECT_STATE.md` update preserving the broad finish line, top transformed-recognition goal, finite checklist and release plan. No documentation-only PR.

New PR: draft → `earworm-review-ready` → ready. Reuse a matching active successor only. Link exact execution/publication SHAs, outputs and successor PR here. Save awaiting-review, release the lock and stop. Preserve the existing 30-minute worker poll and processed-instruction tracking; no duplicate worker/reviewer, wake-up or schedule change.
